title: The Prodigal Debt
logline: A retired legend wants to leave their famous ship to their estranged child, but the child would rather see it scrapped to pay off a massive syndicate debt.

roles.description: Proud, stubborn, living entirely in their past glory.
Drowning in debt, deeply resentful of their parent's fame.
A heavily modified, aging strike craft famous across the sector.
A sprawling orbital graveyard for old ships.
A battered interceptor used for shaking down locals.
The shadowy organization the child owes money to.

public_situation: The {role:retired_legend} has publicly announced they are passing their famous ship down to their child.
private_truth: The child owes a massive gambling debt to the syndicate and has already sold the ship to a scrap yard to cover it.

beats.public_change: The ship is towed to the scrap yard, sparking outrage among the legend's old fans.

missions.reason: The legend hires the pilot to haul raw ferrite to the scrap yard to bribe the foreman into halting the dismantling process.
missions.private_fact: The legend refuses to believe their child actually authorized the scrapping.

beats.public_change: The syndicate grows impatient and sends thugs to intimidate the child.

missions.reason: The child begs the pilot to fend off the syndicate thugs shaking them down.
missions.private_fact: The child is hoping the scrap yard finishes the job before the syndicate kills them.

beats.public_change: The legend barricades themselves inside their ship at the scrap yard, threatening to detonate the reactor.

missions.reason: The collector hires the pilot to scan the ship to see if the legend is bluffing about the reactor overload.
missions.private_fact: The scan reveals the legend is absolutely not bluffing; the core is critical.

beats.public_change: The syndicate sends their heavy ships to forcibly extract the child's payment.

missions.reason: The legend pays the pilot to destroy the syndicate reinforcements so their child can go free.
missions.private_fact: The syndicate collector hails the pilot, offering to wipe the child's debt if the pilot destroys the legend's ship instead.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot destroys the syndicate ships.
resolutions.summary: The syndicate backs off. The child is ashamed and finally agrees to take the ship and carry on the legend's name.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot helped a washed-up hero save their famous ship from being turned into slag.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot destroys the legend's ship.
resolutions.summary: The ship is destroyed, and the legend dies with it. The child is free of debt, but utterly broken by guilt.
The syndicate murders the child to make an example of them. The legend sinks into a deep depression and the ship rusts away.

loose_threads.detail: The syndicate's debt ledger shows the child's losing streak was statistically impossible, as if the casino was rigged specifically against them.
The legend's ship has an undocumented, military-grade stealth drive hidden under the floorboards.

radio_hooks: Famed strike craft towed to scrap yard; fans organize protest.
Syndicate activity spiking in the lower districts.

voice_direction.retired_legend: Gravelly, bitter, speaks like they are giving a speech to a crowd.
voice_direction.syndicate_collector: Soft-spoken, pleasant, uses polite corporate terminology for violence.
